BrochureContent.Content:
DNG Martin O'Connor Estate Agents are delighted to present for sale this impressive four-bedroom detached residence ideally positioned within the mature and highly regarded residential development of The Spires on the Westport Road, Clifden. Occupying a superb site overlooking a large Green area together with views towards the Clifden GAA grounds, the property enjoys an excellent sense of space and convenience while being within a short stroll of Clifden Town Centre and all local amenities.

This well-proportioned home offers bright and spacious accommodation laid out over two floors together with a generous rear garden and ample off-street parking. Built in approximately 2000, the residence offers an excellent opportunity for purchasers seeking a spacious family home, holiday residence or investment property in the heart of Connemara's capital.

A welcoming entrance hallway with tiled flooring leads through to a bright and spacious living room centred around a solid fuel Blacksmith stove, creating a warm and comfortable focal point within the home. Sliding patio doors open directly onto the rear garden, allowing excellent natural light throughout the space. The adjoining kitchen and dining area is fitted with maple kitchen units and tiled flooring together with further patio doors to the rear garden, creating a practical and functional family living space ideal for both everyday use and entertaining.

One of the property's most appealing features is the ground floor bedroom with adjoining en-suite shower room, offering excellent flexibility for guests, multi-generational living or those seeking ground floor accommodation. Upstairs, the property comprises three further bedrooms including a spacious principal bedroom with en-suite and patio doors opening onto a private balcony area overlooking the surrounding development. A well-appointed family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation.

Externally, the residence enjoys a large rear garden offering excellent potential together with generous parking to the front. The property further benefits from oil fired central heating and double-glazed windows throughout. 

Seldom does an opportunity arise to acquire a detached residence of this scale and positioning within walking distance of Clifden Town Centre. The property enjoys immediate access to schools, shops, cafés, restaurants, sporting facilities and the many natural amenities Connemara has to offer, making it an ideal permanent residence, holiday retreat or investment opportunity. In addition, the home presents an exceptional opportunity for prospective purchasers to further enhance and personalise the property to their own style and specification.
